directories.description: The PUBLISHED SITE on GitHub Pages, on the gh-pages branch: main at the root and each other branch at STAGING/<branch-slug>/. Built by `npm run build` into dist/ (never committed) and committed to gh-pages by scripts/publish-gh-pages.sh, which .github/workflows/deploy.yml runs on every push.

The walkthrough's content as TypeScript: the moments and how each person lives them (journeyData.ts), the building blocks and each moment's technical layer (techData.ts), the workshop's policy layer (policyData.ts), the device screens and payloads (storylineData.ts). No cat-harness kind describes the journey map, the per-moment use of a building block or the workshop layer yet: smart-trust-demo bean KG-01.

The six person actors of smart-trust-demo's scenarios, copied unchanged at the commit upstream.lock.json pins. Each actor's meta.persona (name, role, country, goal, needs, frustrations) is the persona journeyData.ts shows. Edit them in smart-trust-demo; scripts/sync-upstream.mjs --check fails on a hand edit. The FHIR examples (src/data/ig/), ArchiMate views (public/archimate/) and BPMN drawings (public/bpmn/) are copied and checked the same way.

publish-gh-pages.sh, which builds the site and commits it to gh-pages, and sync-upstream.mjs, which copies the snapshot from smart-trust-demo at two pinned commits (main for its files, gh-pages for its built site) and checks it offline.
